description: INTEGRANTES DEL BACHILLERATO UTH INTERESADOS EN DESARROLLAR NUESTRA CREATIVIDAD Y HACER UN APORTE DE IMPORTANCIA A LA CIENCIA Y TECNOLOGÍA
summary:
The project is a web based dashboard aimed to inform the user about fire safety in microgravity environments, such as that of a spaceship or a space station.

It summarizes investigations and uses interactive interfaces and a simulation in order to aid in learning.
details:
The web based dashboard contains summaries of combustion science investigations, ranked by their reliability, as well as various interactive tools to help visualize how fire behaves in microgravity environments and how the lack of gravity gives rise to unexpected dangers.

By condensing large amounts of data into brief, relevant and easily legible summaries, it makes it easier to find the knowledge that would actually be useful and practical for someone expecting to be in those environments, while also directing to the full investigations in case a more thorough understanding is necessary.

The dashboard will be powered by an SI assistant that collects and validates reliable and verifiable investigations, which will also be able to interact with the user to help them find the information they need.

It was written in HTML with the aid of Sublime Text and Google Fonts.

With an interactive design, backed by actual data, the aim is to help immerse the user in order to make learning easier.
